entries.text: Woke up haphazardly from a turbulent dream . Feeling currently nervous awaiting the outcome of the election . Concerned about the future . Stressed out about assignments due this week and feeling behind on them .

I feel tired and drained after working . Having to eat feels laborious . I feel emotionally detached as if I’m running on auto-pilot , and just numb . I want to sleep and shut my eyes . I am nervous about the work deadlines and also election results .
Disheartened , Lethargic , Brain dead , Nervous , Uncertain

Feeling detached and dissociated from the world . Feeling reserved and wanting to be alone . Feel the need for reflection and introspection . Want to unload thoughts in writing . Less angry and frustrated since yesterday .

Feeling more energy . Recovering from the blues . Eating a good meal and rest helped . Stressed about the work remaining . Looking forward to seeing close friends tomorrow . Weather is very nice , but unusual and concerning .

I feel calm but sad . I am tired and sleepy . I have trouble focusing on my tasks . I am also having trouble shutting out dark thoughts or concerns about the future . I am worried about the days to come and feel insecure about the future .

I am feeling tired because I could not sleep well . I am dreading going to work , but I am excited to see my friends after work . I am feeling nervous about deadlines and changes occurring in my life and yet I am looking forward to change as well .

I am feeling exhausted from the day before . I feel sad that I can’t rest today . I feel anxious of the lack of time to meet my deadlines . I feel pressure to do well at work and not make mistakes . I feel dreadful for the coming week .
